title: Coligny to Elizabeth, 12 Jan 1563, and Catherine de' Medici to Paul de Foix, 15 Jan 1563, BL Add MS 4136 ff. 142-143, 148v-149 (DECODE R9238, R9241)

documents.route: Gaspard de Coligny (camp at Villefranche) to Elizabeth I (London)

plaintext.source: Forbes, Full View ii (1741) 272-274; CSP Foreign vi no. 76 ('Orig. almost entirely in cipher, deciphered')

transcription.source: DECODE images (Forbes's copy of the ciphered passages)
transcription.notes: 35 numbered passages in graphic signs; not transcribed. Identified by the copyist's margin glosses ('sins', 'desracine') against the printed text. f.143 lower half begins another Coligny letter (catalogue 93).

documents.route: Catherine de' Medici to Paul de Foix, French ambassador in London (intercepted)

plaintext.source: not in Forbes ii, CSP Foreign vi, or La Ferrière, Lettres de Catherine de Médicis i-ii

transcription.notes: First pass, passages (1)-(4); some glyph classes (z/r, b variants) may be merged. f.148 top (passages 15-24) is the end of a Coligny letter and was not transcribed.

system.summary: R9238: Coligny's graphic-sign cipher, about 60 signs, deciphered at the time. R9241: Latin letters, digits, ligatures and a few two-digit numbers with clear null words (pour, car); not one of Forbes's filed keys (Throckmorton first/second/third, Croft); one-token-per-letter homophonic annealing found no language.
system.notes: Clear French null words as in Throckmorton's third cipher, but the sign values do not match it.

prior_solution.where: R9238 only: Forbes, Full View ii (1741) 272-274; CSP Foreign vi (1869) no. 76. R9241: none known.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched R9238 and R9241 (2 images each) with the shared DECODE cookie.

Read the margins: f.142 'L'Amiral de France à la Reine d'Angleterre [1]2 Jan 1562/3'; f.148v 'La Reine-mère de France à Mr de Foix Ambass. en Angleterre 15 Jan 1563'. The two records are different letters.
Grepped Forbes ii OCR and CSP Foreign vi pp. 1-123: Coligny's letters to the Queen are 'almost entirely in cipher, deciphered' (nos. 7, 76) and printed by Forbes.

Margin glosses 'sins', 'desracine' at f.142 passage (9) match 'il rallie les siens ... desraciner du tout l'evangile' in the Villefranche letter of 12 Jan (Forbes ii 272-274), not the 2 Jan Meur letter: R9238 = CSP vi no. 76, read at the time.
Queen Mother to de Foix 15 Jan 1563 searched in Forbes ii, CSP Foreign vi and La Ferrière, Lettres de Catherine de Médicis i-ii: not found.
Compared R9241 with the Forbes key records: Throckmorton's first (R9260 p.2), second (R9260 p.3), third (R9262 p.1) and Croft's (R9261 p.2) ciphers.
Transcribed R9241 passages (1)-(4) into qm_tokens.txt: 952 tokens, 71 types, IoC 0.035.
Homophonic annealing with the shared lang dense 5-gram models (French, English): collapsed to runs of e/s; the model over-scores unseen repeats ('eeee' -0.26/char).
Joint-quadgram annealer (anneal3.py) on a 940-token synthetic homophonic control with 64 types: plaintext almost fully recovered.
anneal3.py on R9241 in French and English, with and without nulls: no language (about -9.8/char).
anneal3.py with Italian (Renaissance), Spanish (Quijote) and Latin corpora: no language.
Two tokens per letter: token parity within each passage is flat, so the hypothesis is not supported.
anneal3.py SYL=1: tokens map to a letter or one of 30 French bigrams; no language.
Second pass, sign by sign from full-resolution crops (two agents, one per page): qm2_tokens.txt, 1007 tokens, 92 types; splits of #/4t/H, 3/Z3, qs/qf, Lc/Yb, b/bB, D/Da and others.
anneal3.py on qm2_tokens.txt (French, English, French with nulls): no language.

Swept DECODE key records 1550-1580 with French plaintext (R335, R355, R331, R3818, R3820). R335 (Condé's cipher, 2 Dec 1562) matches R9238's signs: & and 14 nulls, ω = la Royne d'Angleterre in the heading line. None fits R9241.

outcome.method_basis: The only part counted as read is R9238, identified from the copyist's margin glosses as Coligny's 12 Jan 1563 letter to Elizabeth, deciphered at the time (CSP Foreign vi no. 76) and printed in clear by Forbes, Full View ii 272-274; R9241 (Catherine de' Medici to de Foix) resisted ciphertext-only annealing and remains unread.
outcome.fraction_read_source: R9238 read at the time and printed (Forbes); R9241 not read

gaps.item: R9241 Catherine de' Medici to Paul de Foix, 15 Jan 1563
gaps.detail: No decipherment or clear copy found; homophonic annealing negative on a first-pass transcription. Next: TNA SP 70/49-50 and French register copies.

outcome.notes: Catalogue 92. R9238 closed as already solved (in print); R9241 attempted, open. Status: in progress.
